composition_variation: Illustrate Kiki from Kiki’s Delivery Service standing by a warmly lit bakery window, fully dressed in her loose dark knee-length dress, tights, and comfortable shoes. Preserve her short black hair and large red bow. She holds a small paper bag with no writing and smiles gently. Use hand-painted cel textures, cozy ocher brick, deep cobalt shadows, and warm bread-shaped forms, without broom or animal companion. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
